data.name: RcIntro
data.value: Windows keeps the registry in hive files that do not shrink when data is removed. The analysis writes a compacted copy of each hive to a temporary folder, compares the sizes and deletes the copies. It changes nothing in Windows and needs no restart. CleanSuite does not replace the hives: unlike the original program, it only measures how much space compaction would save.

data.name: SdWhat
data.value: A scheduled run uses the choices each tab starts with and removes what that tab would select after a scan. Junk files and invalid shortcuts go to the Recycle Bin; the registry is cleaned only in the low-risk categories (recent-item lists, sounds, help files, fonts, application paths, Start menu), and its data is exported to a .reg backup first (see the Restore tab); the history items checked by default are cleaned and their files deleted permanently. A run is skipped while CleanSuite is open. Each run is recorded in {0}.
